import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 100001;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long x = sc.nextLong();
        long y = sc.nextLong();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        if (y <= n) {
            long g;
            while ((g = gcd(x, y)) > 1) {
                x /= g;
                y /= g;
            }
            System.out.println(x + "/" + y);
            sc.close();
            return;
        }

        double best_diff = 1e9;
        long best_num = 0;
        long best_den = 1;

        for (long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long h = lcm(i, y);
            long w = x * (h / y);
            double diff1 = (double)(w - ((w / (h / i)) * (h / i))) / (double)h;
            if (best_diff > diff1) {
                best_diff = diff1;
                best_num = (w / (h / i));
                best_den = i;
            }
            long numerator = w + (h / i) - 1;
            long denominator = (h / i);
            double diff2 = Math.abs(w - ((numerator / denominator) * denominator)) / (double)h;
            if (best_diff > diff2) {
                best_diff = diff2;
                best_num = (numerator / denominator);
                best_den = i;
            }
        }

        long g = gcd(best_num, best_den);
        best_num /= g;
        best_den /= g;
        System.out.println(best_num + "/" + best_den);
        sc.close();
    }

    static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long temp = b;
            b = a % b;
            a = temp;
        }
        return a;
    }

    static long lcm(long a, long b) {
        return a * b / gcd(a, b);
    }
}
